items.title: Roger Mitchell Interview, 1972-01-19
items.q: maybe Punch or Chris Kelly, or Ron

ctx.x: Bonkings, yeah. People call them banquets, but they call them bonkings. Banquets, yeah.

Like all these social and pleasure clubs, you know, and the white delias and the young man right there, you know, and all that, they have their, their banquet of maybe a kid and they'll be at the, at the, at the Carburetors, at the economy hall, maybe Punch or Chris Kelly, or Ron, yeah, by the Jean-Sami and another band, Santa Sinsa and another band. This is all on Monday?
Sure. All on Monday. And they play while people ate?
